welcome.title: A tour of the gel images
welcome.text: Every gel and blot image uploaded to Phoresis, with what was done with it. A one-minute tour; Esc leaves it, the Tour compass at the top brings it back.

steps.title: Find an image
steps.text: Search a file name or a description, then narrow by assay, gel type or who uploaded it: tick the values, choose the sort order, then Filter. The filters stay in the address, so a filtered list can be bookmarked.

steps.title: Analyzed or not yet
steps.text: Not analyzed keeps the images no one has analysed: the work still to do.

steps.title: One image
steps.text: Its thumbnail, its assay (or its gel type while it has none) and how many analyses it carries. Click it to open the image and its analyses.

steps.title: Add an image
steps.text: Upload gel adds a new image and asks what it is read for.
